description: This file defines interfaces and mock implementations for a DummySpnegoAuthenticator used in Android for testing GSSAPI negotiate authentication, including classes, constants, and function declarations.

classes.name: GssContextMockImpl
classes.description: Mock implementation of GSSAPI context for testing purposes.

classes.name: DummySpnegoAuthenticator
